title: Toxic effect of silica nanoparticles on endothelial cells through DNA damage response via Chk1-dependent G2/M checkpoint

grounded.context: general mammalian cells, statement cited from other work
grounded.evidence_quote: Checkpoint kinase 1 (Chk1), which is an essential kinase required to preserve genome stability, is activated in response to DNA damage and is involved in the cell cycle checkpoint control, DNA damage repair and DNA damage-induced apoptosis [53], [54].
